purpose: Test whether the exact three-partition-matroid carrier can be recolored/regrouped into two partition matroids and then solved by ordinary two-matroid intersection. An induced claw around a mixed degree-3 minority occurrence proves that three partition layers are locally necessary.

local_claw.center: M, the minority-sign occurrence of a mixed degree-3 Boolean variable.
local_claw.semantics: L,R are the two same-sign majority occurrences. N is another literal occurrence in M's clause and belongs to a different Boolean variable. Thus ML and MR are sign conflicts, MN is a clause conflict, while LR,LN,RN are legal compatible pairs.
local_claw.Tovey_alignment: In the standard bounded-occurrence copy-cycle reduction, a minority copy occurrence in a 2-clause has exactly this configuration: two opposite-sign conflicts inside its copy variable plus the other endpoint of the 2-clause.

theorem.name: INDUCED_CLAW_REQUIRES_THREE_EXACT_PARTITION_CONFLICT_LAYERS
theorem.statement: If a conflict graph contains an induced K_{1,3}, it cannot be represented exactly as the union of the conflict graphs of only two partition matroids. Three layers are necessary for the claw, and the canonical M_C,M_L,M_R construction supplies three layers for the full bounded-occurrence carrier.
proof: The conflict graph of one partition matroid is a disjoint union of cliques: two elements conflict exactly when they lie in one capacity-1 block.

Consider one layer and the claw center M. If that layer contained two incident claw edges, say ML and MR, then L,M,R would lie in one partition block by transitivity of block membership. It would therefore also contain the false conflict LR, contradicting that the claw is induced.
Hence each exact partition layer can contain at most one of ML,MR,MN.
Covering all three true conflict edges without adding a false leaf-leaf conflict requires at least three layers.

The canonical carrier uses exactly three: M_C carries MN (and all same-clause conflicts), M_L carries one sign edge, and M_R carries the other sign edge. Thus the local partition-layer number is exactly three.

killed: Recolor all exact pair conflicts into only two partition matroids and invoke ordinary matroid intersection.
Merge M_C,M_L,M_R into two exact capacity-1 block systems without auxiliary/global structure.
not_killed: Two more expressive global delta-matroids with nonlocal coupling.

next_target.name: E8_THREE_LAYER_CLAW_BLOSSOM_AUGMENTATION_V3_2
next_target.directive: Treat the induced claw, not an individual pair conflict, as the atomic defect. Search for a blossom-like contraction/augmentation rule that resolves a whole minority-centered claw while preserving clause witness cardinality and that composes globally in polynomially many contractions.
